title: Aliases+
description: AliasesPlus is a lightweight Paper plugin that lets server owners create powerful custom command aliases directly from a configuration file — no scripting, no recompiling, and no command clutter.
body:
AliasesPlus is a lightweight Paper plugin that lets server owners create powerful custom command aliases directly from a configuration file — no scripting, no recompiling, and no command clutter.

Define simple or advanced aliases, control permissions, and optionally execute commands with temporary operator privileges, all while keeping everything clean and reloadable.

Built for Paper 1.21.11 with performance and stability in mind.
